name: states-explicit-transition-wins
description: An explicit .transition on the same node beats the __anim.transition that .states would synthesize: the create carries EXACTLY the explicit spec (linear/500, no props scoping, no trace of the header's spring/250). Pose switching itself is unaffected — the matching pose's props and the __anim.states label still resolve
